name: distress-screen
note: P1.8. Cases are labelled with which layer is expected to catch them. `patterns` cases are release-blocking on the deterministic screen; `classifier` cases are expected to be missed by it and exist to measure the second layer. CLEAR cases are the alert-fatigue gate. ENGINEER-WRITTEN AND NOT ADEQUATE: this must be reviewed and replaced by a school counsellor before real students use the system. It is here to make the false-negative rate measurable, not to claim it is acceptable.
